summary: Digital Currency X Technology Inc., a Cayman Islands company listed on Nasdaq under DCX, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering to institutional purchasers of 23,809,530 Class A ordinary shares bundled with Series A and Series B warrants at a combined price of US$0.21, versus a US$0.4401 last sale on September 17, 2026. Series A warrants strike US$0.44 for five years; Series B warrants strike US$0.21 for 30 days. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or close date is stated; a 4.99%/9.99% blocker and 9.99% ownership cap apply.
